recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If ClinicalAssessment is restored to the active build later, preserve ClinicalAssessment.protocol at 0..* unless Patient Care makes a new explicit decision.

initial_application: Historical commit 127b8fa2717d9a7b08169daaf955d8a9c3ec9aa5 explicitly listed #7762 and changed the ClinicalImpression.protocol spreadsheet row from 0..1 to 0..*. Checked-in release history shows release2 at max 1 and release3 and later at max *.
additional_context: FHIR-46596 later renamed ClinicalImpression to ClinicalAssessment and is already represented on the combined branch. A later source/fhir.ini change removed ClinicalAssessment from active resource/config lists, so neither ClinicalImpression nor ClinicalAssessment is currently active in the build, though retained source files remain in the tree.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the historical application and retained current source already match the approved repeatable cardinality, and there is no active build-scope resource entry to adjust.
